Secure heights cannot excuse betrayal of a brother

Verses 11–14 follow Edom’s conduct step by step. First it stood aside while Jerusalem was looted. Then it gloated, entered the city, and took plunder. Verse 14 names the last step. Edom waited at the crossroads for those who had escaped. It killed some and handed over the rest. Verse 10 calls the victim “your brother Jacob,” which makes it betrayal.
